description: This file defines the Matrix class for managing matrices, including creation, validation, subsetting, and mathematical operations, with external dependencies on LU and QR decomposition classes.

classes.name: Matrix
classes.description: A class for creating and manipulating matrices, including validation, subsetting, and solving linear systems.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Matrix object from a 2D array of values.

methods.name: buildFromArray
methods.description: Initializes the matrix grid from an array, setting rows and columns.

methods.name: validateRow
methods.description: Validates that a row index is a positive integer.

methods.name: validateColumn
methods.description: Validates that a column index is a positive integer.

methods.name: validateRowInRange
methods.description: Checks if a row index is within the matrix's row range.

methods.name: validateColumnInRange
methods.description: Checks if a column index is within the matrix's column range.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Returns a subset of rows as a new Matrix.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns a subset of columns as a new Matrix.

methods.name: dropRows
methods.description: Removes specified rows and returns a new Matrix.

methods.name: dropColumns
methods.description: Removes specified columns and returns a new Matrix.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specific cell.

methods.name: rows
methods.description: Generator yielding each row as a vector or value.

methods.name: columns
methods.description: Generator yielding each column as a vector or value.

methods.name: isSquare
methods.description: Checks if the matrix is square.

methods.name: isVector
methods.description: Checks if the matrix is a vector.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the matrix as a 2D array.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Solves the linear system A*X = B using LU or QR decomposition.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Provides read-only access to properties like rows and columns.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Dynamically calls matrix functions or operations.
